keyword: has anyone won back to back masters

verifications.claim: Three golfers have won the Masters back-to-back in its history.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: R1: 'only three golfers – Jack Nicklaus (1965-66), Nick Faldo (1989-90) and Tiger Woods (2001-02)'; R3: lists three; R4/R5/R6: list four including Rory McIlroy (2025-26); R7: 'only three back-to-back winners'
verifications.reasoning: Some sources state exactly three (R1, R3, R7), while others state four including McIlroy (R4, R5, R6), creating direct contradiction.
